lore_summary: A creature of the Ancient Vaults, aligned with Arcane energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Young Pawn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Pawn Cursed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Pawn Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Pawn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Pawn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Pawn Cursed bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Pawn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Pawn Cursed — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Pawn Cursed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Pawn Cursed Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Pawn Cursed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Pawn Curseds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_7.name: Eternal Pawn Cursed
star_7.appearance: The final form. Pawn Cursed stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Pawn Cursed is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Primordial Golem
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Primordial Golem — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Primordial Golem is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Primordial Golem the Last
star_6.appearance: Primordial Golem now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Primordial Golems have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_7.name: Origin Primordial Golem
star_7.appearance: The final form. Primordial Golem stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Primordial Golem is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Shard Xorn Tamed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Shard Xorn Tamed the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Shard Xorn Tamed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.name: Spawn Shadowed Medusa
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shadowed Medusa. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Shadowed Medusas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Shadowed Medusa
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Wisp Giant Rust Monster

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Lesser Mites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Lesser Mite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Lesser Mite
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Lesser Mite bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Lesser Mite
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Lesser Mite — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Lesser Mite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Lesser Mite of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Lesser Mite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Lesser Mites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_7.name: God-King Lesser Mite

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Newborn Myconid
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Myconid. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Myconids in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Myconid

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Bud Plague Duergar
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague Duergar. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Plague Duergars in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Plague Duergar
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Ultimate Larloch Perfecteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Ultimate Larloch Perfected
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Lesser Infernal Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Infernal Iron Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Infernal Iron Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Infernal Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Young Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Scourge Revenant
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scourge Revenant. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Scourge Revenants in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Scourge Revenant
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Spawn Void Vampire
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Void Vampire. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Void Vampires in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Void Vampire

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Exalted Elder Vampire
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Exalted Elder Vampire — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Exalted Elder Vampire is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Exalted Elder Vampire the Last
star_6.appearance: Exalted Elder Vampire now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Exalted Elder Vampires have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_7.name: Final Exalted Elder Vampire
star_7.appearance: The final form. Exalted Elder Vampire stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Exalted Elder Vampire is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Undying Beholder

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Quarried Xorn Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Quarried Xorn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Quarried Xorn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Quarried Xorn Cursed bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Quarried Xorn Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Quarried Xorn Cursed — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Quarried Xorn Cursed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Quarried Xorn Cursed the True
star_6.appearance: Quarried Xorn Cursed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Quarried Xorn Curseds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_7.name: Last Form Quarried Xorn Cursed
star_7.appearance: The final form. Quarried Xorn Cursed stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Quarried Xorn Cursed is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

base_chain.name: Spawn Doppelganger VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Doppelganger VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Fledgling Forager IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Forager IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Forager IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Forager IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

lore_summary: A creature of the Ancient Vaults, aligned with Arcane energy. Known among tamers as a Insectoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Seed Herald Death Tyrant
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Herald Death Tyrant. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Herald Death Tyrants in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Herald Death Tyrant
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Herald Death Tyrant bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Pup Feral Digger

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Feral Diggers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Feral Digger

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Bud Undying Arcane Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Undying Arcane Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Undying Arcane Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Undying Arcane Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

lore_summary: A creature of the Ancient Vaults, aligned with Arcane energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Kobold
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Kobold. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Kobolds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Kobold
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Dim Kobold
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Kobold bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Bud Chaos Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chaos Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Chaos Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Chaos Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Lesser Duergar Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Duergar Elite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Duergar Elites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Duergar Elite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Duergar Elite
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Duergar Elite bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Duergar Elite
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Duergar Elite — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Duergar Elite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Duergar Elite Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Duergar Elite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Duergar Elites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_7.name: Legend Duergar Elite
star_7.appearance: The final form. Duergar Elite stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Duergar Elite is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nibbler. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Nibbler

base_chain.name: Spawn Centipede Omega
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Centipede Omega. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Centipede Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Centipede Omega
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Pup Eternal Mind Flayer
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Eternal Mind Flayer. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Eternal Mind Flayers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Eternal Mind Flayer
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Eternal Mind Flayer
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Eternal Mind Flayer bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Eternal Mind Flayer
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Eternal Mind Flayer is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Eternal Mind Flayer the True
star_6.appearance: Eternal Mind Flayer now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Eternal Mind Flayers have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_7.name: Last Form Eternal Mind Flayer
star_7.appearance: The final form. Eternal Mind Flayer stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Spawn Jagged Doppelganger VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Jagged Doppelganger VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Jagged Doppelganger VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Jagged Doppelganger VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Bud Beetle Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Beetle Prime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Beetle Primes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Beetle Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Seed Doppelganger
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Doppelganger. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Doppelgangers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Doppelganger

lore_summary: A creature of the Ancient Vaults, aligned with Arcane energy. Known among tamers as a Draconic-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Young Relentless Ancient Blue Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Relentless Ancient Blue Dragon. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Relentless Ancient Blue Dragons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Relentless Ancient Blue Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Spawn Goblin Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Goblin Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Goblin Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Goblin Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Weedy Goblin Major
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Goblin Major bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Goblin Major
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Goblin Major — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Goblin Major is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Goblin Major the True
star_6.appearance: Goblin Major now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Goblin Majors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_7.name: Sublime Goblin Major

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

tamer_note: Arcane tamers are called Scribes. Bond is formed through shared research — the monster must learn something from you.

base_chain.name: Bud Meager Worker Tamed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Meager Worker Tamed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Meager Worker Tameds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Meager Worker Tamed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Meager Worker Tamed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Meager Worker Tamed bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Meager Worker Tamed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Meager Worker Tamed — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Meager Worker Tamed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Meager Worker Tamed the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Meager Worker Tamed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Meager Worker Tameds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_7.name: Eternal Meager Worker Tamed
star_7.appearance: The final form. Meager Worker Tamed stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Meager Worker Tamed is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Arcane Bone Naga. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Ancient Vaults. Arcane Bone Nagas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Arcane Bone Naga
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Arcane — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Ancient Vaults. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Arcane Bone Naga
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Arcane Bone Naga bears the aesthetic of Ancient Vaults — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Arcane crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Ancient Vaults. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  knowledge keeps itself. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Arcane Bone Naga
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Ancient Vaults-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Sage Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Ancient Vaults, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Arcane Bone Naga — Sage Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Sage path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Sage Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Arcane Bone Naga is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Ancient Vaults. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Arcane Bone Naga of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Arcane Bone Naga now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Arcane Bone Nagas have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_7.name: God-King Arcane Bone Naga
star_7.appearance: The final form. Arcane Bone Naga stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Arcane Bone Naga is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Vault Unsealed" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%
